ola/modules/cable/ - Cable, reflection with short-circuited end
When it is seen: measurement in reflection with the far end short-circuited.
What to draw: like image 2, but the far connector has a short circuit (a short cap, or the
short symbol: the two contacts joined), with the word SHORT.
Details: make images 2 and 3 with the same setup, so that it is seen that only the far end
Save your drawing with this name (.svg, .png, .jpg or .webp). While this file is here, the program uses its own diagram.
